scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification explicitly overrides it

conditions: the opening genuinely has no door
the jamb is a real physical vertical surface
the floor finish reaches the jamb

urban_rules.principle: SKIRTING FOLLOWS REAL SKIRTING-ELIGIBLE WALL SURFACE AT FLOOR LEVEL; a plan-cut opening is not a floor opening without vertical evidence
urban_rules.trade: SKIRTING (and the hidden profile on the same path, US-08)
never: a window deduction from plan geometry alone
a sill height transferred between projects

window_fact_versions.received: R8.16 brief §1, §4 (after source exhaustion: no sill / schedule / section in the DXF)

statement.text: for the CURRENT selected Qortuba plan, NORMAL WINDOWS START APPROXIMATELY 1.00 m ABOVE FINISHED FLOOR: there is real wall between the finished floor and the sill
statement.sill_is: approximate; a vertical fact, never a plan dimension
statement.applies_to: normal windows: a glazing occurrence hosted IN a wall whose face line runs across the opening (the plan draws the wall below the sill)
does_not_apply_to: a glazed opening with no wall line across it (e.g. a glazed screen)
statement.source_first: a source sill / schedule / section would override this fact

transfer_forbidden: the old Qortuba revision (QP-17 / QP-18 stay old-revision rules)
any other Qortuba revision, region or plan variant
